plugins.name: professor-course-skills
plugins.description: This host's own course-level skills: onboarding, concept maps, term planning, assessment design, gap analysis, grading, dashboards and reporting, written against the AINAR record layer.

plugins.name: professor-assignment-skills
plugins.description: Create aligned homework, labs, seminars, and practice sessions at selectable depth from course context.

plugins.name: professor-course-design-skills
plugins.description: Design and review aligned courses at selectable depth using the Professor DataLayer course structure.

plugins.name: professor-exam-skills
plugins.description: Create aligned exams, questions, marking guides, rubrics, and equivalent variants at the depth the request needs.

plugins.name: professor-lms-publishing-skills
plugins.description: Preview and explicitly publish professor-approved content to Canvas, Moodle, or Telegram.

plugins.name: professor-slides-skills
plugins.description: Plan, write and render course presentations at the depth the request needs — fast, standard or deep — from a Supabase course database, a YAML course directory, or a single flat course file.

plugins.name: professor-student-assessment-skills
plugins.description: Draft evidence-cited grading suggestions, moderate decisions, and prepare feedback without auto-approving grades.
